# 74195 - 4-bit parallel-access shift register

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74195.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74195.json)

| 7 | D | input |  |  | parallel data |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 15,14,13,12 | QA..QD = Q[0..3] | Register bits. |
| 11 | /QD = NOT QD | Complement output of the last stage. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 4

Changes on: rising edge of CLOCK

- CLEAR' low: QA..QD = L, QD' = H at once
- CLEAR' high, SHIFT/LOAD' low, clock rising: QA..QD = A,B,C,D (serial inputs ignored)
- CLEAR' high, SHIFT/LOAD' high, CLOCK low: no change
- Shift (SHIFT/LOAD' high, clock rising): QB=QAn, QC=QBn, QD=QCn, and QA from J,K':
-   J=L, K'=H: QA = QAn (no change)
-   J=L, K'=L: QA = L
-   J=H, K'=H: QA = H
-   J=H, K'=L: QA = NOT QAn (toggle)

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| /CLEAR | QA..QD | PHL | 19 | 30 |
| CLOCK | QA..QD, QD' | PLH | 14 | 22 |
| CLOCK | QA..QD, QD' | PHL | 17 | 26 |
